curated.tagline: Self-hostable, agent-native issue tracker where humans and agents share one board
curated.description: Self-hostable, agent-native issue tracker where humans and AI agents work the same board. Issues move through one state machine whether a person or an agent moves them, and every change is written to an append-only event log with the actor's identity. Agents reach the board through an MCP server, a CLI with JSON output, or a REST API. AGPL-3.0, with the MCP server and CLI under MIT.
highlights: Humans and agents move issues through one state machine, with an append-only event log attributed to the actor
Three ways in for agents: an MCP server (stdio and Streamable HTTP), a CLI with --json output, and a REST API with an OpenAPI document
Keyboard-first web app: issue list, board, triage inbox, review queue, cycles, insights and a roadmap timeline
Self-hostable with Docker Compose and Postgres; AGPL-3.0, MCP server and CLI under MIT
curated.architecture: Web UI, agents (MCP, CLI, REST), GitHub App and Slack → Hono API (state machine, auth, scopes) → Postgres (issues + event log) → signed webhooks and agent harness dispatch
